task.title: Render file-structure drift in CodeWiki UI
task.summary: Present TASK-010 intended/current file-structure drift data in an existing CodeWiki UI or status surface for human review.

goal.outcome: Maintainers can review intended structure, current structure, approved migration deltas, and actionable file-structure drift through an existing human-visible CodeWiki surface.
acceptance: The surface consumes generated graph/status/audit drift data rather than duplicating file-structure truth.
Approved migration deltas are visually/report-wise separate from actionable drift.
Source paths and canonical refs are available for every displayed claim.
No new user-facing command is added unless existing UI/status surfaces cannot host the data safely.
Existing public package behavior remains compatible.
non_goals: Do not make generated UI output canonical truth.
Do not add a broad new product mode beyond the review surface.

delta.desired: The accepted human-driven structure review surface has executable UI/status work queued.
delta.current: TASK-010 exposed graph/audit data only; no human UI/report surface task remained open.
delta.closure: Task closes when maintainers can inspect intended/current/delta/drift data in an existing CodeWiki human surface with source refs.
